transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before we start building the maintenance sequence, I need to flag something important. That tester is reserved for V-31 from 0800 to 1100 Tuesday. This reservation is in the maintenance shop log but hasn't been copied to the company schedule yet, so I want to make sure we account for it as we plan the team's work windows. With that on the table, let's hear updates from each of the representatives so we can put together a sequence for Capt. Morgan's approval.
